title: Selecting duration of no announcements for carbs required does not work correctly
body: No matter which duration I select (i.e. one of 5, 15 or 30 minutes) the result is always 30 minutes. It appears that all 3 possibilities get added to **intent** but the set for 15 minutes overwrites the preceding 5 minute set and then finally the 30 minute set overwrites that again. Changing that sequence in the code confirmed my suspicion that it is always the last option which gets activated.
